name: omnetpp-ini
description: OMNeT++ ini files: highlighting, '#' comments, completion, hover, go to definition, diagnostics and running configs

omnetppIni.diagnostics.unknownParameters.description: Warn about keys whose parameter does not exist in the NED modules they match (resolved from the network of the ini file).

omnetppIni.codeLens.enable.description: Show Run / Qtenv / Cluster above each section.

omnetppIni.omnetppRoot.description: OMNeT++ installation (OMNET_ROOT). Used to count runs with opp_run and exported to the terminals. Empty: use the OMNET_ROOT environment variable.

omnetppIni.run.script.description: Script that runs a config locally, relative to the workspace folder. Called as: <script> [-r <runs>] [-Qt] <ini> <config>.

omnetppIni.run.extraArgs.description: Extra options for the run script (e.g. -b to compile first).

omnetppIni.cluster.script.description: Script that launches configs on the cluster, relative to the workspace folder. Called as: <script> [options] <user> <ini> <config>[,<config>...].

omnetppIni.cluster.extraArgs.description: Extra options for the cluster script (e.g. -m 8 -p <partition> --tmp).

omnetppIni.debug.debugger.description: Debugger extension: CodeLLDB (lldb), Microsoft C/C++ (cppdbg), or the first one installed (auto).

omnetppIni.debug.program.description: Debug binary, relative to the workspace folder. Empty: <workspace folder name>_dbg, as built by ./build.sh debug.

omnetppIni.debug.buildCommand.description: Command that builds the debug binary when it is missing.

omnetppIni.debug.userInterface.description: OMNeT++ user interface for debug sessions.

omnetppIni.debug.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for the simulation in debug sessions (e.g. --cmdenv-express-mode=false).
